units.rawText: In the desert of southern Texas, a military vehicle races down a highway.
units.displayText: In the desert of southern Texas, a military vehicle races down a highway.

spans.text: In the desert of southern Texas, a military vehicle races down a highway.

units.rawText: Centaureissi sits in the back seat, a yellowed letter in hand.
units.displayText: Centaureissi sits in the back seat, a yellowed letter in hand.

spans.text: Centaureissi sits in the back seat, a yellowed letter in hand.

units.rawText: "This is a receiving contract with Universal Anything Services. Mother and Father left me a sum of money, which I've used to purchase long-term maintenance services for you. After you return, ownership will remain in my name, but you don't need to continue to work. You are free to pursue what you want to do."
units.displayText: "This is a receiving contract with Universal Anything Services. Mother and Father left me a sum of money, which I've used to purchase long-term maintenance services for you. After you return, ownership will remain in my name, but you don't need to continue to work. You are free to pursue what you want to do."

spans.text: "This is a receiving contract with Universal Anything Services. Mother and Father left me a sum of money, which I've used to purchase long-term maintenance services for you. After you return, ownership will remain in my name, but you don't need to continue to work. You are free to pursue what you want to do."

units.rawText: "I have enlisted and am going to go searching for Mother and Father. Do not follow me, Reissi. Don't come to the battlefield. This is my last command to you as your master. I'm sorry that I was unable to say this to you face-to-face. I didn't dare... I'm sorry."
units.displayText: "I have enlisted and am going to go searching for Mother and Father. Do not follow me, Reissi. Don't come to the battlefield. This is my last command to you as your master. I'm sorry that I was unable to say this to you face-to-face. I didn't dare... I'm sorry."

spans.text: "I have enlisted and am going to go searching for Mother and Father. Do not follow me, Reissi. Don't come to the battlefield. This is my last command to you as your master. I'm sorry that I was unable to say this to you face-to-face. I didn't dare... I'm sorry."

units.rawText:
"Please take care of yourself."<|>
"Your little sis, always and forever, Vayne."
units.displayText:
"Please take care of yourself."
"Your little sis, always and forever, Vayne."

spans.text: "Please take care of yourself."
"Your little sis, always and forever, Vayne."

units.rawText: She unconsciously strokes the letter. The creases on it are no longer distinct, probably because she's opened it too many times. Only the howling of the wind brings her back to her senses and she carefully tucks the letter back into her pocket.
units.displayText: She unconsciously strokes the letter. The creases on it are no longer distinct, probably because she's opened it too many times. Only the howling of the wind brings her back to her senses and she carefully tucks the letter back into her pocket.

units.rawText: The sound of distant gunfire is slowly drawing closer, and the shape of the military base in the distance is now clear.
units.displayText: The sound of distant gunfire is slowly drawing closer, and the shape of the military base in the distance is now clear.

spans.text: The sound of distant gunfire is slowly drawing closer, and the shape of the military base in the distance is now clear.

units.rawText: Laredo Military Sector, outpost entrance.
units.displayText: Laredo Military Sector, outpost entrance.

spans.text: Laredo Military Sector, outpost entrance.

units.rawText: Please verify your information.
units.displayText: Please verify your information.

spans.text: Please verify your information.

units.rawText: Model: Butler-36. Name: Centaureissi. Owner: Vayne. Sender: Universal Anything Services.
units.displayText: Model: Butler-36. Name: Centaureissi. Owner: Vayne. Sender: Universal Anything Services.

spans.text: Model: Butler-36. Name: Centaureissi. Owner: Vayne. Sender: Universal Anything Services.

units.rawText: Now performing identity verification... Verification complete.
units.displayText: Now performing identity verification... Verification complete.

spans.text: Now performing identity verification... Verification complete.

units.rawText: Welcome, Centaureissi. Please register at the logistics department. Your queue number is: 036.
units.displayText: Welcome, Centaureissi. Please register at the logistics department. Your queue number is: 036.

spans.text: Welcome, Centaureissi. Please register at the logistics department. Your queue number is: 036.

units.rawText: Thank you.
units.displayText: Thank you.

spans.text: Thank you.

units.rawText: She arrives at the designated waiting area, where a soldier seated on a bench is waiting to be called.
units.displayText: She arrives at the designated waiting area, where a soldier seated on a bench is waiting to be called.

spans.text: She arrives at the designated waiting area, where a soldier seated on a bench is waiting to be called.

units.rawText: What the hell, ANOTHER tin can?
units.displayText: What the hell, ANOTHER tin can?

spans.text: What the hell, ANOTHER tin can?

units.rawText: Aren't you all supposed to be back in the factory pounding out ingots? Why are you all running to the war zone one after another?
units.displayText: Aren't you all supposed to be back in the factory pounding out ingots? Why are you all running to the war zone one after another?

spans.text: Aren't you all supposed to be back in the factory pounding out ingots? Why are you all running to the war zone one after another?

units.rawText: Centaureissi ignores him. Instead, she silently finds an empty seat near the back of the room and sits down.
units.displayText: Centaureissi ignores him. Instead, she silently finds an empty seat near the back of the room and sits down.

spans.text: Centaureissi ignores him. Instead, she silently finds an empty seat near the back of the room and sits down.

units.rawText: What's this? Don't even know how to answer a human being?
units.displayText: What's this? Don't even know how to answer a human being?

spans.text: What's this? Don't even know how to answer a human being?

units.rawText: Seriously, what the hell are all these big corporations thinking? Sending us piles of scrap like this? Am I going to be stuck talking to them in logistics?
units.displayText: Seriously, what the hell are all these big corporations thinking? Sending us piles of scrap like this? Am I going to be stuck talking to them in logistics?

spans.text: Seriously, what the hell are all these big corporations thinking? Sending us piles of scrap like this? Am I going to be stuck talking to them in logistics?

units.rawText: Frustrated, the soldier turns and reveals the crutch in front of him.
units.displayText: Frustrated, the soldier turns and reveals the crutch in front of him.

spans.text: Frustrated, the soldier turns and reveals the crutch in front of him.

units.rawText: Do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth?
units.displayText: Do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth?

spans.text: Do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth?

units.rawText: ...Yes, I do.
units.displayText: ...Yes, I do.

spans.text: ...Yes, I do.

units.rawText: But your words just now could not be recognized as an effective order, and you do not have officer permissions, so you cannot issue orders to me.
units.displayText: But your words just now could not be recognized as an effective order, and you do not have officer permissions, so you cannot issue orders to me.

spans.text: But your words just now could not be recognized as an effective order, and you do not have officer permissions, so you cannot issue orders to me.

units.rawText: Why, you—
units.displayText: Why, you—

spans.text: Why, you—

units.rawText: Just as the soldier is about to fly into a fit of rage, the weighty sound of a door opening suddenly comes down the corridor.
units.displayText: Just as the soldier is about to fly into a fit of rage, the weighty sound of a door opening suddenly comes down the corridor.

spans.text: Just as the soldier is about to fly into a fit of rage, the weighty sound of a door opening suddenly comes down the corridor.

units.rawText: We made it! Man, I can't count how many mouthfuls of sand we had to swallow on the way here... Although I don't have a mouth, haha!
units.displayText: We made it! Man, I can't count how many mouthfuls of sand we had to swallow on the way here... Although I don't have a mouth, haha!

spans.text: We made it! Man, I can't count how many mouthfuls of sand we had to swallow on the way here... Although I don't have a mouth, haha!

units.rawText: ...Please remain quiet while waiting in line.
units.displayText: ...Please remain quiet while waiting in line.

spans.text: ...Please remain quiet while waiting in line.

units.rawText: The tall Doll in black approaches while carrying a massive coffin, her face blank. Upon seeing her, the soldier's expression changes from furious to fearful.
units.displayText: The tall Doll in black approaches while carrying a massive coffin, her face blank. Upon seeing her, the soldier's expression changes from furious to fearful.

spans.text: The tall Doll in black approaches while carrying a massive coffin, her face blank. Upon seeing her, the soldier's expression changes from furious to fearful.

units.rawText: Shit, she even brought that out... You tin cans...
units.displayText: Shit, she even brought that out... You tin cans...

spans.text: Shit, she even brought that out... You tin cans...

units.rawText: Next, No. 35.
units.displayText: Next, No. 35.

spans.text: Next, No. 35.

units.rawText: Just then, an announcement fills the air. The soldier immediately seizes the excuse to limp off.
units.displayText: Just then, an announcement fills the air. The soldier immediately seizes the excuse to limp off.

spans.text: Just then, an announcement fills the air. The soldier immediately seizes the excuse to limp off.

units.rawText: Thank you for your help just now.
units.displayText: Thank you for your help just now.

spans.text: Thank you for your help just now.

units.rawText: ...I did not do anything.
units.displayText: ...I did not do anything.

spans.text: ...I did not do anything.

units.rawText: I know, but I am thankful nonetheless.
units.displayText: I know, but I am thankful nonetheless.

spans.text: I know, but I am thankful nonetheless.

units.rawText: Perhaps it's because she recognizes the other Doll as being from UAS as well, but Centaureissi feels relieved. She indicates that Clotho should take a seat too.
units.displayText: Perhaps it's because she recognizes the other Doll as being from UAS as well, but Centaureissi feels relieved. She indicates that Clotho should take a seat too.

spans.text: Perhaps it's because she recognizes the other Doll as being from UAS as well, but Centaureissi feels relieved. She indicates that Clotho should take a seat too.

units.rawText: Think nothing of it! I've often said that I'm quite a badass, seeing as how I can scare assholes off just by standing here, but nobody believed me! You've seen the proof now, right? Haha!
units.displayText: Think nothing of it! I've often said that I'm quite a badass, seeing as how I can scare assholes off just by standing here, but nobody believed me! You've seen the proof now, right? Haha!

spans.text: Think nothing of it! I've often said that I'm quite a badass, seeing as how I can scare assholes off just by standing here, but nobody believed me! You've seen the proof now, right? Haha!

units.rawText: That soldier was hardly an "asshole". Perhaps he was just being... oversensitive on account of being taken off the frontline.
units.displayText: That soldier was hardly an "asshole". Perhaps he was just being... oversensitive on account of being taken off the frontline.

spans.text: That soldier was hardly an "asshole". Perhaps he was just being... oversensitive on account of being taken off the frontline.

units.rawText: Such things are not uncommon on the battlefield.
units.displayText: Such things are not uncommon on the battlefield.

spans.text: Such things are not uncommon on the battlefield.

units.rawText: Say, Miss, you look like you've seen a lot and understand people well, but most importantly—you look cool as hell! Is that the legendary maid outfit?
units.displayText: Say, Miss, you look like you've seen a lot and understand people well, but most importantly—you look cool as hell! Is that the legendary maid outfit?

spans.text: Say, Miss, you look like you've seen a lot and understand people well, but most importantly—you look cool as hell! Is that the legendary maid outfit?

units.rawText: Thank you for your praise. Your appearance is also... quite unique...
units.displayText: Thank you for your praise. Your appearance is also... quite unique...

spans.text: Thank you for your praise. Your appearance is also... quite unique...

units.rawText: I know, right? I think so too!
units.displayText: I know, right? I think so too!

spans.text: I know, right? I think so too!

units.rawText: Why don't we make friends? You can call me Hel, and this is my master, Clotho!
units.displayText: Why don't we make friends? You can call me Hel, and this is my master, Clotho!

spans.text: Why don't we make friends? You can call me Hel, and this is my master, Clotho!

units.rawText: I am the domestic services Doll Centaureissi. Please to meet you.
units.displayText: I am the domestic services Doll Centaureissi. Please to meet you.

spans.text: I am the domestic services Doll Centaureissi. Please to meet you.

units.rawText: Your master seems a little... reluctant to speak? Is this her first time at a military camp?
units.displayText: Your master seems a little... reluctant to speak? Is this her first time at a military camp?

spans.text: Your master seems a little... reluctant to speak? Is this her first time at a military camp?

units.rawText: Of course! Military camps aren't as common now as they were ten-plus years ago! Ah, of course I didn't personally see what things were like ten-plus years ago, seeing that I'm not that old—but that's what my database says!
units.displayText: Of course! Military camps aren't as common now as they were ten-plus years ago! Ah, of course I didn't personally see what things were like ten-plus years ago, seeing that I'm not that old—but that's what my database says!

spans.text: Of course! Military camps aren't as common now as they were ten-plus years ago! Ah, of course I didn't personally see what things were like ten-plus years ago, seeing that I'm not that old—but that's what my database says!

units.rawText: Still, she's not keeping quiet because she's afraid of ghosts. Isn't that right? With Death as our oldest friend, what's there to fear about a stranger or two?
units.displayText: Still, she's not keeping quiet because she's afraid of ghosts. Isn't that right? With Death as our oldest friend, what's there to fear about a stranger or two?

spans.text: Still, she's not keeping quiet because she's afraid of ghosts. Isn't that right? With Death as our oldest friend, what's there to fear about a stranger or two?

units.rawText: ...Okay, okay, that's kind of a lame joke; it's not quite enough to cheer her up. Don't worry, just give her a while and she'll be much better.
units.displayText: ...Okay, okay, that's kind of a lame joke; it's not quite enough to cheer her up. Don't worry, just give her a while and she'll be much better.

spans.text: ...Okay, okay, that's kind of a lame joke; it's not quite enough to cheer her up. Don't worry, just give her a while and she'll be much better.

units.rawText: Then I hope you and your master will be in better spirits tomorrow, Hel.
units.displayText: Then I hope you and your master will be in better spirits tomorrow, Hel.

spans.text: Then I hope you and your master will be in better spirits tomorrow, Hel.

units.rawText: Thanks, Miss Centaureissi! After all, we might end up being colleagues soon, right? Nobody likes working with a sourpuss! So you need to cheer up too, Clotho...
units.displayText: Thanks, Miss Centaureissi! After all, we might end up being colleagues soon, right? Nobody likes working with a sourpuss! So you need to cheer up too, Clotho...

spans.text: Thanks, Miss Centaureissi! After all, we might end up being colleagues soon, right? Nobody likes working with a sourpuss! So you need to cheer up too, Clotho...

units.displayText: Next, No. 36.

spans.text: Next, No. 36.

units.rawText: Pardon me, but I must take my leave.
units.displayText: Pardon me, but I must take my leave.

spans.text: Pardon me, but I must take my leave.

units.rawText: No problem, no problem! All the best, Miss Centaureissi!
units.displayText: No problem, no problem! All the best, Miss Centaureissi!

spans.text: No problem, no problem! All the best, Miss Centaureissi!

units.rawText: Centaureissi nods, and then bids the strange pair farewell.
units.displayText: Centaureissi nods, and then bids the strange pair farewell.
